title: Lawn parties and closing of the tape
summary: He explains lawn parties in yards and Gretna, played for white and Black crowds in any weather; the tape then ends.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well, a lawn party was this. People used to get a lawn party in the yard, you know what I mean?

Yards, you know. Like some people had a backyard, you know. Well I used to play parties in the Kretna. Used to have three or four parties like tonight, Monday night, you know what I mean? You know what I mean? It was in the rain. All they wanted the rain was to stop falling. That wouldn't stop them from coming out, you know what I mean? I played lawn parties over here for white, for colored, and the other ones. All down below the cut-offs played parties down there, you know what I mean? on the ground, naked ground, you know what I mean? And things like that. Don't care how much rain would fall, the people would come up right on. And when they get too dead, they're going to be dry this floor here. They didn't know that much, you know what I mean? Shut up. I always played a lot of parties, you know what I mean? It was nice, you know what I mean? Them days when, you know, we used to give all these parties. Well, you had different entertainers to go, now you don't have nowhere to go. You don't have nowhere to go.
Yeah, that's the end of the tape, so I don't think we don't have anywhere to go, but back it up and listen to it. Yeah, yeah. So thank you a million, Thomas. We'll be back it up.
